text: Small repeated pushes can produce a large motion when their timing matches an oscillator's resonant response.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: OpenStax, University Physics Volume 1, section 15.6; https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-1/pages/15-6-forced-oscillations. Consulted 2026-10-13. Independently worded factual explanation; no OpenStax prose is reproduced.

text: Lightly damped oscillators respond strongly over a narrower band of driving frequencies. Heavier damping broadens and reduces the response.
